content.text: {"comps":[{"label":"C1","good":true,"reason":"Single-family and attached homebuilder selling to individual buyers through its own sales centers, with mortgage services; same business as the target."},{"label":"C2","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to first-time buyers, with in-house mortgage and title services; closely matches the target."},{"label":"C3","good":false,"reason":"Develops and sells finished lots to homebuilders as a B2B lot developer, not building and selling homes to consumers."},{"label":"C4","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to individual buyers in Sunbelt markets, with affiliated mortgage financing; same business."},{"label":"C5","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family and attached homes to first-time and move-up buyers, with mortgage and title subsidiaries; same business."},{"label":"C6","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family homes and townhomes to homebuyers with in-house mortgage and title services; same core business."},{"label":"C7","good":false,"reason":"Underwrites title, mortgage guaranty and general insurance policies; an insurance business rather than home construction and sales."},{"label":"C8","good":false,"reason":"Primarily life insurance, cemeteries and mortuaries, with mortgage lending only as a side line; not a homebuilder."},{"label":"C9","good":true,"reason":"Builds and sells single-family detached and attached homes to first-time, move-up and active adult buyers with affiliated mortgage services; same business."},{"label":"C10","good":false,"reason":"Diversified across land sales, hotels, clubs, restaurants and timber in one region; homebuilding is only part of a broader resort and hospitality business."}]}
